new_observation_basis.reference_resolution_basis: Pinned parser interpretation at emitted in-CU reference offsets; valid parse is not independent lexical-boundary certification.

nonclaims: No fresh ELF/DWARF query, relocation decoding or old semantic/checker execution in proposed CI/reader
No independent lexical DIE-boundary certification; emitted references are pinned-parser interpretations
No newly measured inherited210 graph, callback signature or pointed-to layout
No observed pointer byte width, member storage extent or new type alignment
No active runtime union alternative, allocation, provider availability, registration/callback behavior
No whole-layout or binary ABI/toolchain equivalence

relation_policy.attributes_absence: Absent byte_size/alignment/width stays absent and unknown. Reject invented alignment/pointer-size or unlisted attributes/forms; do not synthesize member storage extents.
relation_policy.closure: Recompute complete per-role nodes/candidates/unique direct children/counts from lists, exactly one anchor per role, four direct members each for production profile, all78 new nodes complete/reachable, no duplicate/missing/cross-role/extra nodes, by-value cycles or unknown refs; inherited and pointer context sets exact. Never trust status/count markers as sufficient proof.
relation_policy.inherited_stop: Require exact role-specific target ID in the one accepted boundary pair plus exact generated parent/context membership; no traversal, metadata remeasurement or name-based substitute.
relation_policy.level: Finite parser-observation-level relation of newly reported direct union member/by-value metadata only
relation_policy.member_match: Exactly one direct member per emitted DW_AT_name byte value AND form within the exact paired parent context; require exact reported location form/value/raw_value, no defaults. No name-only inherited relaxation.
relation_policy.pairing: Compute a bijective new-node pairing from paired anchors, unique child names and type edges. Preserve role-local sharing/parent context; exact tag and form/resolved reported value equality. Raw strp offsets and CU-local reference offsets are retained as role-specific evidence, not cross-CU equality or lexical certificates.
relation_policy.pointer_stop: Only pointer node tag/ref-form/presence and role-local raw ref validation; context and node sharing paired, no pointee identity/equivalence/signature/extent claim.
relation_policy.reference_check: Exact role-local ref4 value/raw_value integers; target CU offset+raw_value within inherited CU bounds, frozen reference basis. Resolve new by-value refs only to exact new nodes or admitted inherited pair/context; pointer target never resolved/traversed.
relation_policy.result: Report new comparison evidence and explicit stops/nonclaims; no whole union layout equivalence or broader ABI acceptance.
